determinations.caution: The subsidiary is a publication gateway, not necessarily the reporting parent. Art. 40a reporting runs for financial years beginning on or after 1 January 2028 (R-012).
The revised ESRS were adopted 3 Jul 2026 but were NOT in force at the pack snapshot; they must not alter current obligations until legal effectiveness (Change Watch CW-001).
CSRD is directive-based law. A negative EU-level threshold result with this gate unresolved must read 'EU-level threshold not met; national-law status requires review' — never 'CSRD does not apply'.

A standalone promotional sustainability report is not automatically sufficient. First reporting year is decided per route by CSRD-S-017 and CSRD-S-018 (Article 5(2) of Directive (EU) 2022/2464); the filing calendar and the exercised national options resolve through the national overlay (CSRD-S-013), and no answer here is a final legal conclusion until the country pack is ratified.
Provider eligibility and appointment rules require the national overlay. Limited assurance remains the mandatory level; the assurance standard is due by 1 July 2027.

The Directive's own calendar. Which measures apply in a given year is decided by the governing Member State's transposition (CSRD-S-013); the FY2025–26 national derogation on the individual basis is CSRD-S-004. Issuers reach this route because admission to a regulated market makes them public-interest entities; the Transparency Directive measures of Article 5(2), third subparagraph, are not encoded. Article 1(3) as amended conditions the extension to credit institutions and insurance undertakings regardless of legal form on the amended thresholds; whether that narrows the first-wave route for such undertakings below those thresholds is an open source question recorded in the design.

The Directive's own calendar. Which measures apply in a given year is decided by the governing Member State's transposition (CSRD-S-013); the FY2025–26 national derogation on the consolidated basis is CSRD-S-022. Issuers reach this route because admission to a regulated market makes them public-interest entities; the Transparency Directive measures of Article 5(2), third subparagraph, are not encoded. Article 1(3) as amended conditions the extension to credit institutions and insurance undertakings regardless of legal form on the amended thresholds; whether that narrows the first-wave route for such undertakings below those thresholds is an open source question recorded in the design.

Scope and exemption are separate determinations: 'threshold in scope but exempt' must never be summarised as 'CSRD does not apply'. 'EQUIVALENT' requires a formal equivalence basis — treat as legal judgment with a signed DecisionRecord until an equivalence decision exists (as CSRD-S-006). Credit institutions permanently affiliated to a central body, insurance undertakings under group supervision and the Article 48i transitional reporting are analyst and country-pack matters; the reporting parent's country is stated (parent.reporting_parent_country), never inferred from the ultimate parent's. Exemption evidence must remain current every year (O-011).
